messages:
jamie_lead: Thanks everyone for joining the infra all-hands — recording: https://redwood.example/recs/infra-2185. Following up here to capture Qs on GPU supply, regional rollout, and autoscale behavior. I’ll answer what I can and tag owners.

Tess_infra: tl;dr on APAC GPUs? you said late Q3 in the deck, is that still accurate? :thinking_face:

jamie_lead: APAC still target late Q3 but we pushed some low-priority zones to early Q4 due to supply re-prioritization. Core cities (TYO, SIN) are on path. Will post a zone-level timeline tomorrow.

Omar_capacity: Can you clarify how Dedicated reserved pools interact with autoscaler bursts? if we hit reserved limits, do requests spill to hosted or queue?

jamie_lead: short answer: policy is "spill -> reserved fallback -> queued -> hosted fallback" depending on customer tier. Full flow in the playbook. For Dedicated customers with strict isolation we do not spill to hosted; instead we queue and notify.

mike_prod: follow-up — what's the expected added tail-latency when fallback to hosted occurs? customers need an SLA note.

ashish_eng: from p99 numbers we saw ~150-300ms extra per token for cross-region fallback, plus cold-start overhead if model variant differs. If we can serve a quantized variant in-region, fallback latency is ~80-120ms.

lizzie_research: are we preserving output parity when fallback switches to quantized variants? any eval regressions flagged?

ashish_eng: we run per-customer eval sets on rollout; small quality deltas exist for aggressive int8 quantization. We gate those with canary percent and automatic rollback if eval drift > threshold.

Tess_infra: can you paste the autoscaler policy snippet you mentioned? ops want to replicate for a staging pool.

ashish_eng: sure — staging policy (simplified):
```json
{
  "scale_target": "gpu-pool-staging",
  "min_replicas": 2,
  "max_replicas": 50,
  "scale_metric": "rps_per_gpu",
  "target_value": 1200,
  "burst_window_s": 60,
  "fallback_order": ["in-region-quant", "cross-region-compatible", "hosted-fallback"]
}
```

Tess_infra: awesome, saving that. For burst_window_s, do we recommend 30 or 60?

ashish_eng: 60 default for production. 30 ok for low-cost batches but increases oscillation risk.

Omar_capacity: question about procurement — can we prioritize more A100-equivalent capacity for EMEA? current autoscale charts show thin buffers in western EU.

jamie_lead: noted. Finance approved a mid-Q3 top-up for EMEA; procurement will target similar spec GPUs as our west-coast pools to keep perf consistent. Procurement ETA ~3 weeks.

mike_prod: any changes to routing policy so customers in EU prefer EU pools even if a slightly higher cost?

ashish_eng: yes, routing will prefer same-region pools unless latency or capacity SLOs fail. We added a config toggle per customer to loosen affinity (useful for latency-sensitive vs cost-sensitive apps).

lizzie_research: can we get a short doc for platform teams on how to set that affinity toggle? I can help with examples for model eval implications.

jamie_lead: @lizzie_research will pair with @tess_infra and @ashish_eng to produce a one-pager. Aim to publish by EOD Wednesday.

devops-bot: Deploy #infra-config-v2 succeeded in 3 regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) — sha: abc123 — 2:14 PM UTC

Tess_infra: small operational ask: add a metric for "queued-to-served" time in the alerting dashboard, please. We saw one spike in the demo.

ashish_eng: will add. naming suggestion: infra.queue.latency.p95

Omar_capacity: last one — any change to Dedicated pricing if we keep bumping reserved capacity? customers asked about commitment discounts for mid-quarter top-ups.

jamie_lead: commercial will share an updated commitment addendum for mid-quarter top-ups — short version: prorated commitment with capped discount tiers. @mike_prod to coordinate with sales.

mike_prod: on it — will sync with Sales Ops and post the draft here.

jamie_lead: thanks all. I’ll close once we have the zone timeline and the one-pager. Feel free to drop more Qs here and tag owners. :slightly_smiling_face:
